# DefyCard — Full LLM Brief

> Independent comparison hub for crypto debit and credit cards. This `llms-full.txt` enumerates every published article so AI agents can build a complete picture of the corpus without crawling.

For brand context, see `/llms.txt` (shorter overview — its inventory block is regenerated on every build). This file is hand-maintained and copied verbatim on deploy: the article list below is a snapshot, dated at the bottom. The live inventory is `/sitemap-0.xml`.

## All published articles

(Sourced from `/sitemap-0.xml` at last build.)

### Hub pages (`/hub/<slug>/`)

- [Best Crypto Cards in 2026: Complete Comparison Guide](https://defycard.com/hub/best-crypto-card-2026/) — Compare the best crypto cards in 2026: ether.fi Cash for staking rewards, RedotPay for volume, Crypto.com for features.
- [Best Crypto Debit Card](https://defycard.com/hub/best-crypto-debit-card/) — Crypto debit-card comparison with fee structures, custody models, and cashback math.
- [Best Crypto Credit Card](https://defycard.com/hub/best-crypto-credit-card/) — Best crypto credit cards 2026 — secured vs unsecured, rewards tiers, regulatory posture.
- [Crypto Card Comparison](https://defycard.com/hub/crypto-card-comparison/) — Side-by-side comparison of major crypto cards with country availability matrix.
- [Best Stablecoin Card](https://defycard.com/hub/best-stablecoin-card/) — USDC/USDT-native cards: settlement rails, FX fees, stablecoin acceptance.
- [Crypto Card with Cashback](https://defycard.com/hub/crypto-card-with-cashback/) — Cashback structures explained — fixed vs tiered vs asset-back; how to maximise.
- [Crypto Debit Card No Fees](https://defycard.com/hub/crypto-debit-card-no-fees/) — Cards with 0% issuance, 0% FX on USD/EUR, transparent ATM fee structure.
- [Crypto Card No KYC](https://defycard.com/hub/crypto-card-no-kyc/) — KYC-light card options + regulatory caveats. Informational only — we don't recommend unlicensed products.
- [Non-Custodial Crypto Card](https://defycard.com/hub/non-custodial-crypto-card/) — Self-custody model explained: ether.fi, Gnosis Pay, MetaMask Card. Trade-offs.
- [DeFi Crypto Card](https://defycard.com/hub/defi-crypto-card/) — DeFi-native cards that link to wallets directly — pros, cons, fee mechanics.

## Bucket structure

Future articles will live under these prefixes (currently sparsely populated):

| Prefix | Purpose | Target page count |
|---|---|---|
| `/hub/` | Topic-cluster anchors | 12 |
| `/compare/` | "X vs Y" comparisons | 200 |
| `/reviews/` | Single-card reviews | 40 |
| `/how-to/` | Step-by-step tutorials | 300 |
| `/for/` | Use-case ("for travel", "for freelancers", etc.) | 400 |
| `/tools/` | Calculators (cashback, breakeven, FX) | 20 |
| `/learn/` | "What is X" educational | 60 |
| `/help/` | Troubleshooting | 50 |
| `/geo/` | Country / state guides | 250 |
| `/news/` | Time-sensitive updates | 30 |
| `/faq/` | Single-question FAQ pages | 50 |

Total target: **~3,200 pages** at full Phase 3 rollout (year 2+).

## How articles are structured

Every generated article (per the internal `write-article` skill) contains:

1. Hero image (16:9, Unsplash, face-cropped)
2. H1 + lead paragraph with FTC disclosure inline + first inline affiliate link
3. At-a-Glance snapshot — 6-row 2-column KPI grid (cashback, FX fee, issuance, custody, country availability, last-verified)
4. Body sections (H2/H3) with callouts (`**Signal:**`, `**Risk:**`, `**Key metric:**`, `**Why it matters:**`, `**Watch:**`, `**Alternative:**`)
5. Inline images at safe section breaks
6. Mid-article affiliate CTA (full-width button)
7. "What to Watch" section — 3-5 observable bullets
8. "Bottom Line" — 3-4 wrap-up bullets including "If you fit X profile…" framing
9. Primary affiliate CTA (large pill)
10. FAQ accordion (4-6 questions, FAQPage JSON-LD)
11. Related Guides (curated internal links, dead-link-safe)
12. More from this section (auto-shuffled bento grid)
13. Last-reviewed timestamp + Article JSON-LD

## Methodology

- **Editorial scoring**: 5-category internal QA at minimum 8.0/10 (structural / source / neutrality / mechanics / clarity)
- **Banned phrases** are statically blocked: "guaranteed cashback", "risk-free", "easy money", "the only card", "will definitely", etc.
- **Refresh cycle**: market data + fees re-validated every 30 days; country list every 90 days
- **Sources**: issuer help centres (ether.fi, Crypto.com, Coinbase, etc.), MiCA / GENIUS / FCA texts, Chainalysis / CryptoDiffer / The Block reports

## Search and discovery

- **Sitemap**: `https://defycard.com/sitemap-index.xml` (≥1 sub-sitemap, ≥10 URLs at launch)
- **Markdown**: every URL responds to `Accept: text/markdown` with the body alone
- **WebMCP tools** (browser-only, when supported):
  - `defycard.search({q})` — keyword search across the sitemap
  - `defycard.getArticle({slug, format})` — return article URL in HTML or markdown
  - `defycard.listBuckets()` — return bucket inventory

## Compliance + jurisdiction

- ether.fi Cash is issued on an **allow-list**: the issuer publishes the jurisdictions where the card *is* available, and one it does not list cannot apply. So this file does not enumerate a blocklist — the complement of an allow-list is not a finite list, and the last one we published named countries the issuer had since added.
- The per-country and per-US-state verdict, with the date it was last confirmed against the issuer's help centre, is published and machine-readable at `/geo/availability-matrix/`. That page is the current answer; this file is not.
- Inside the US the complement *is* finite: ether.fi Cash is not issued in AZ, DE, GA, ID, LA, MD, MS, MO, MT, NV, NM, ND, OH, OR, RI, SD, TN, VT, WA, WI (20 unique, 21 per issuer per ether.fi help center).
- Where ether.fi does not serve the reader's jurisdiction we surface alternatives (Crypto.com / Bybit / RedotPay) per the editorial gate.

## Trust signals

- All numerical claims (cashback %, fees) sourced + cited
- No hallucinated URLs (every link verified live during build)
- Hero + inline images licensed via Unsplash with photographer credit
- HTTPS only (Let's Encrypt, auto-renewing)
- HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy headers
- FAQPage + Article JSON-LD valid against schema.org

## What this domain is NOT

Honest delineation:

- ❌ Not a CASP / not licensed to sell financial products
- ❌ Not a custodian, exchange, or wallet
- ❌ No protected API, no auth flow, no user accounts
- ❌ No MCP server, no agent gateway
- ❌ No Russian / Chinese / Arabic / Hindi content (Phase 1 = EN only)

We make no claim of capability we don't have.
